verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Justworks automatically collects W-4 filing/withholding info during employee enrollment, implying some self-serve onboarding data collection, but there is no documentation of I-9 collection or bank/direct-deposit details being gathered via a self-serve pre-day-one flow. Missing for 10: explicit I-9 collection workflow, bank account/direct deposit setup during onboarding, and confirmation the flow completes before the employee's start date.
